fk.tool_axis: directed local Z expressed in base

dataset_generation.strategy: Uniform operating-box joint witnesses; rejection by exact runtime self/table validity; independent current pools
dataset_generation.split_unit: FK target group before current pairing
dataset_generation.target_leakage: No target_id or exact XYZ+directed-axis label crosses splits
dataset_generation.supervision: Known reachable FK witness, not an IK solver success claim

robot.goal: selected joint goal from XYZ + directed flange Z; local Z spin free

scene.scene_checker: PyBullet convex URDF hulls versus table and one axis-aligned box
scene.execution: kinematic reference interpolation; no calibrated dynamics or physical IO

training.objective: Best-of-eight directed FK task loss plus separate best-of-eight normalized q1-q5 witness loss; tiny travel regularizer
training.scope: Virtual initial guesses only; raw network outputs never certify reachability or collision freedom
